headline: Front-Line Holdings Shift Amid Renewed Fighting
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger records a sharper and more unsettled contest across the principal fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest sector, with 53 base events in 24 hours and six in the latest two-hour watch; its holdings now stand at five Warden, two Colonial, and two neutral bases. Linn Mercy has climbed to 35 events, eight in the latest watch, while casualty and enlistment rates accelerate around Lathair and neighboring positions. Nevish Line has reached 33 events, including two in six hours, and continues to list six Warden and two Colonial bases. Marban Hollow shows 30 events, though none in the latest two-hour window, with four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral base. Mooring County has 24 events and now lists all twelve bases under Warden control after recent exchanges. Kuura Strand, quieter at six events, has seen fighting at Faden Point and retains six Colonial bases. Heavy, rapidly intensifying casualty traffic also marks Callahan’s Passage, Stonecradle, and Morgens Crossing, though their event ledgers are presently sparse.
